question:
Simplify

 (5x - 4)² - (5x + 4)² .
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Using the direct algebraic identity: (a − b)² − (a + b)² = −4ab Here, a = 5x and b = 4 ⇒ Result = −4 × (5x) × (4) ⇒ Result = −80x **∴ The correct answer is −80x.**
